visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a rectangular black lacquered box filled with glazed unagi rice. A red silicone spatula slices through the thick, grilled eel and soft-boiled egg, revealing the rice underneath. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of multiple unagi skewers being grilled over glowing red charcoal. Smoke rises as the eels are flipped, showing a charred, glistening surface. (3) A full Japanese set meal is presented on a wooden table, featuring the unagi box, a bowl of hotpot, and several small side dishes in colorful ceramic bowls. (4) Close-ups of fresh oysters in a bubbling hotpot follow, with mushrooms, broccoli, and cabbage surrounding the seafood. (5) A hand is shown dipping a large piece of eel into a deep pot of dark, shimmering glaze. (6) The glazed eel is returned to the charcoal grill, where the heat makes the sauce bubble and caramelize. (7) A bowl of 'Unagyu Don' is showcased, combining sliced grilled eel with thin strips of A5 Wagyu beef and a translucent onsen egg. (8) Chopsticks lift a slice of the marbled Wagyu beef, glistening with fat and juice. (9) A small ceramic cup of chawanmushi is displayed, topped with bright orange salmon roe and a piece of golden sea urchin. (10) Various side dishes, including pickled radishes and miso soup with tofu, are shown in quick succession. (11) A glass jar of yellow jelly dessert is lifted with a spoon. (12) The video returns to the oyster hotpot, showing the broth being ladled and the large, plump oysters being dipped in sauce. (13) Large red shrimp are added to the hotpot in a new sequence. (14) Fresh oysters on the half-shell, topped with uni and roe, are presented on a bed of ice. (15) The scene shifts to the restaurant's menu, listing various unagi set prices. (16) The final shots show the interior of the restaurant with wooden tables and Japanese banners, followed by the exterior storefront adorned with traditional lanterns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice begins a high-energy narration over a light, upbeat acoustic pop background track featuring bright guitar strumming and a soft piano melody. (2) As the narrator describes the charcoal grilling, a subtle, low-frequency sizzling sound is audible beneath the music. Her speech rate is consistently fast and enthusiastic. (3) The audio maintains a steady rhythm as the narrator lists the various components of the set meal, with the music providing a constant, cheerful atmosphere. (4) In the final phase, the narration slows slightly to emphasize the restaurant's address and the call to action, while the BGM volume dips before a final fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for a Japanese restaurant named 'Unagi Don' (鰻心丼) in Kaohsiung. It highlights the quality of their charcoal-grilled eel, A5 Wagyu beef, and variety of hotpots to attract food enthusiasts looking for premium dining experiences.
